channel.title: Mastery Path — What's New
channel.description: Updates, new lessons and features across the Mastery Path network of 66 free courses.

item.title: New course: DSA & Coding Interviews Mastery Path
item.description: A data structures, algorithms and coding interview course: 40 lessons with tested Python solutions, from Big-O and hashing through graphs, DP and segment trees to mock interviews, online assessments and study plans.

item.title: New course: React Mastery Path
item.description: A hooks-first React course: 40 lessons across four levels, from a first Vite component to Server Components, concurrent rendering, security and large-app architecture, with a project closing each level.

item.title: Cross-site search and lesson progress tracking added network-wide
item.description: A fuzzy search bar on the hub now searches all 2,565 lessons across every course at once. Every one of the 64 sites also got lesson-completion checkboxes and a per-level progress bar, saved locally in your browser — no account needed.

item.title: YouTube video walkthroughs embedded across the network
item.description: Matching video walkthroughs from the Mastery Path YouTube channel are now embedded directly on 99+ lesson pages across python, javascript, shell, typescript, sql, c, java, cpp, go, ruby, php and rust.

item.title: Full Level 2-4 content backfilled on 7 course sites
item.description: ai-ml, docker, github, kubernetes, llm-dev, terraform and workday now have complete Level 2 through Level 4 content — real, mechanism-level lessons in place of every remaining placeholder page.

item.title: "How It Actually Works" sections added to every real lesson, network-wide
item.description: Every existing topic module across all 64 sites now includes a dedicated section explaining the underlying mechanism — not just how to use a feature, but why it behaves the way it does.

item.title: Content license published: CC BY 4.0 for lessons, MIT for code
item.description: All written lessons across the network are licensed CC BY 4.0, and every code snippet is additionally released under the MIT License — free to share, adapt and reuse.

item.title: Mastery Path hub page launched
item.description: A real hub page replaced the old redirect stub — a categorized directory of all 64 free courses, in one place.
